Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.games.solitaire

Class SolitaireModel

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.games.solitaire.SolitaireModel
public class SolitaireModel extends Object
A complete Klondike solitaire engine: a 52-card deck dealt into seven tableau piles, a stock that draws one card at a time and recycles, four foundations built up by suit from Ace to King, and tableau stacks built down in alternating colours. Kings (or a King-headed run) fill an empty column, the top face-down card of a column flips up when exposed, and the game is won once every foundation is complete.

The engine is pure Java (no lg3d / AWT dependency) so it can be exercised headlessly. A card is an int suit * 13 + rank with suit 0=club, 1=diamond, 2=heart, 3=spade and rank 0=Ace .. 12=King; diamonds and hearts are red. Every action snapshots the state first, so undo() rolls back exactly one move.
